## Service: associations (Associations API)

Documentation for Associations API

### Create Association
POST /associations/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/associations/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/associations/create-association | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/associations/create-association.md

Allow you to create contact - contact , contact - custom objects and business - contact associations, will add more in the future.Documentation Link - https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-293776/cd0f4122abc04d3

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: associations.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) createAssociationReqDto:
- locationId* string (e.g. "string")
- key* string (e.g. "student_teacher") - Association's Unique key
- firstObjectLabel* object (e.g. "student") - First Objects Association Label (custom_objects.children)
- firstObjectKey* object (e.g. "custom_objects.children") - First Objects Key
- secondObjectLabel* object (e.g. "Teacher") - Second Object Association Label (contact)
- secondObjectKey* object (e.g. "contact") - Second Objects Key

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- locationId* string
- id* string
- key* string - First Objects Association Label (custom_objects.children)
- firstObjectLabel* object - First Objects Association Label (custom_objects.children)
- firstObjectKey* object - First Objects Key
- secondObjectLabel* object - Second Object Association Label (contact)
- secondObjectKey* object - Second Objects Key
- associationType* object - Association Type can be USER_DEFINED or SYSTEM_DEFINED

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create Relation for you associated entities.
POST /associations/relations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/associations/relations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/associations/create-relation | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/associations/create-relation.md

Create Relation.Documentation Link - https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-293776/cd0f4122abc04d3

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: associations/relation.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) createRelationReqDto:
- locationId* string (e.g. "clF1LD04GTUKN3b3XuOj") - Your Sub Account's ID
- associationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Association's Id
- firstRecordId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - First Record's Id. For instance, if you have an association between a contact and a custom object, and you specify the contact as the first object while creating the association, then your firstRecordId would be the contactId
- secondRecordId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Second Record's Id.For instance, if you have an association between a contact and a custom object, and you specify the custom object as the second entity while creating the association, then your secondRecordId would be the customObject record Id

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- locationId* string
- id* string
- key* string - First Objects Association Label (custom_objects.children)
- firstObjectLabel* object - First Objects Association Label (custom_objects.children)
- firstObjectKey* object - First Objects Key
- secondObjectLabel* object - Second Object Association Label (contact)
- secondObjectKey* object - Second Objects Key
- associationType* object - Association Type can be USER_DEFINED or SYSTEM_DEFINED

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
